headline: Sensex rises over 500 points and Nifty nears 25,300 driven by FII inflows, FMCG, and bank gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign fund inflows and FII buying supported the rally across Indian equity benchmarks.
Strong buying interest in FMCG and banking stocks buoyed Sensex and Nifty 50.
BSE Insurance index posted gains of 1.15%, contributing to overall bullish sentiment.
Positive broader market momentum pushed Nifty close to the 25,300 mark during the trading day.
whatHappening: Sensex gained over 500 points while Nifty 50 ended near 25,291 led by FMCG shares.
Hindustan Zinc announced plans to invest ₹80,000 crore to scale production capacity to 2 million tonnes.
Tata Motors PV slumped 8.7% after JLR cut its margin outlook for FY27.
MCL set its IPO price band at ₹129-136 as Coal India aims to raise ₹9,000 crore.
summary: Indian benchmark indices closed higher on November 16, 2026, driven by foreign fund inflows and gains in banking and FMCG stocks. Sensex gained over 500 points while Nifty 50 closed near the 25,300 level. Max Healthcare emerged as a top gainer, whereas Tata Motors slumped 8.7% following a margin outlook cut by JLR.
